description: This file implements the RemoteKeyMintOperation class, which manages cryptographic key operations such as update, finish, and abort, for Android's hardware security keymint module. It interacts with the keymaster interface and handles request/response processing for remote key operations.

classes.name: RemoteKeyMintOperation
classes.description: A class that manages remote key operations such as update, finish, and abort, interfacing with the keymaster hardware abstraction layer.

methods.name: updateAad
methods.description: Updates the Additional Authenticated Data (AAD) for an ongoing cryptographic operation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Feeds input data into an ongoing cryptographic operation and retrieves the output.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Completes a cryptographic operation, optionally providing input data, signature, and confirmation token, and retrieves the final output.
